standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Descent on Spaces, lemma descend-unibranch (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces to the algebraically closed case along the covering.

standard_prerequisites.name: Restriction to a field extension
standard_prerequisites.use: The covering properties used in the reduction.

standard_prerequisites.name: Minimal primes of a tensor product of strictly henselian local rings
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: More on Algebra, lemma minimal-primes-tensor-strictly-henselian (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Pairs of minimal primes of C correspond to pairs (p, p') in A.

core_obligations: Reduce by restriction and descent to k algebraically closed with r an automorphism-anchored point, then move r to the identity e.
Take the etale-local rings A of R at e and C of R x_{s,U,t} R at (e, e); pair minimal primes via the More on Algebra lemma.
Use flatness of c^sharp and the two commutative unit diagrams to force (c^sharp)^{-1}(q) = p = p'.
proof_roadmap: Point-moving reduction, then a minimal-prime pairing argument through the flat composition law.
difficulty_reason: The minimal-prime pairing through the two unit diagrams is the non-routine core.
